findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present
findings.comment:
6-501.112: There are observed a number of dead insects under the shelving units holding the liquor in the storage room. Ensure cleaning takes place to remove these dead insets from the facility. Ensure cleaning is done at a frequency necessary to prevent the accumulation of dead insects. 
6-501.112: Dead or trapped birds, insects, rodents, and other pests shall be removed from control devices and the PREMISES at a frequency that prevents their accumulation, decomposition, or the attraction of pests.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.12: There is observed a spill in the walk-in cooler under the beer section. Ensure cleaning takes place to clean under the shelving and then ensure cleaning takes place at a frequency necessary to maintain it clean. 
6-501.12: (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.11: The hand sinks in the men’s and women’s restroom are observed to not have caulking to create a smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable surface. Ensure caulking or some sort of sealant is placed in these locations to prevent the accumulation of soils in the crevices where the sink meets the wall. 
6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.
